name: Rizuhble's Smoking Gun Danny
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, for Diviner's Kevlar.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-7,200 (levels 1-13). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Close The Deal unlocked. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Swift Striker. Ultimate (Close The Deal) is available from Grit.

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Swift Striker completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Swift Striker completes 4.8k weapon in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Swift Striker completes 3,200 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Swift Striker completes 4.8k weapon in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Express Shot
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Swift Striker completes 800 souls on. Upgrade of High-Velocity Rounds (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: imminent: Swift Striker completes 4.8k weapon in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Swift Striker
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 18 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of Rapid Rounds (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Grit
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spirit Shielding, 4800 souls (~4.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 15 to Chimera Mk1's explosion damage (1.50x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Extra Health
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spirit Shielding, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 7,200-22,400 (levels 13-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Strix Salvo T3, Jettison Fuel T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Strix Salvo, coated damage) grows from 124 to 214. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Spirit Shielding, spirit 4.8k at Surge of Power.

items.name: Fortitude
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Spirit Shielding completes 800 souls on. Upgrade of Extra Health (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: imminent: Spirit Shielding completes 4.8k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Spirit Shielding
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus. Temporary: sell it later, for Spirit Resilience. Upgrade of Grit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Imbued on Jettison Fuel: its duration-scaled parts (duration 2s, buff duration 7s) get +22%.

items.name: Toxic Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 46 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Surge of Power
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Jettison Fuel: +28 spirit on that ability only, about +26.6 on its scorch damage (0.95x scaling). Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Close The Deal stun duration (0.5s), Strix Salvo coated duration (10s), Jettison Fuel buff duration (7s). Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power. Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 6,400 to 8,000 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 9,600 invested: bonus 42 to 46 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 25,600-48,000 (levels 28-35). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Close The Deal T3.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 8,000 to 14,400 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 8,000 to 12,800 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Lucky Shot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 14,400 to 20,800 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

items.name: Siphon Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 14,400 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Warp Stone.
sections.desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Warp Stone.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun and Metal Skin isn't enough.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Knockdown before it lands, Slowing Hex, Disarming Hex.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Chimera Mk1 (channelled). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns and silences keep catching you.

items.name: Inhibitor
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 14,400 to 20,800 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Silencer
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 20,800 to 24,000 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Jettison Fuel: resets its 14s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Takes spirit from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Replaces Warp Stone: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: On Jettison Fuel. Sell Warp Stone for this, or Swift Striker if it's gone.
